title: MightyNate98's Panoramas
description: This resource pack(s) adds cool paoramas to your Minecraft Java title screen.
body:
# MightyNate98's Panorama Pack

## By MightyNate98

This pack gives you custom panoramas straight from my Minecraft worlds, along with other visual touches and unique scenes I’ve captured while playing.

Every panorama is hand-picked to showcase interesting builds, landscapes, and moments from my survival and creative worlds.

## Features
- High-quality in-game world panoramas
- Personal screenshots from MightyNate98’s worlds
- Extra visual variations and additions
- Regular updates with new scenes

Bring a more personal and immersive feel to your menus and loading screens with this pack made by MightyNate98.
